allowed_reads: FGDC definitions/enumerated domains for CallingIndex, AirTemp, DaysSinceRain, UnifiedProtocol, SkippedStop, State, RunID, StopNumber
marginal CallingIndex category frequencies only to distinguish positive-calling from zero/non-detection semantics
nonmissing coverage of AirTemp and DaysSinceRain among standardized events
nonmissing coverage of route/state/survey date and exact RunID×StopNumber join
marginal number of positive-calling species per event after CallingIndex semantics are publisher-defined
no association between richness and weather
forbidden_reads: effect direction/magnitude for temperature or rainfall

primary_predictor_selection_rule.requirement: nonmissing on >=0.70 of structurally eligible standardized events and publisher definition is interpretable as days since rainfall
primary_predictor_selection_rule.fallback_requirement: nonmissing on >=0.80 of structurally eligible events
